reproduction_contract.note: rom reads lam_eff out of the panel's eigenVECTOR basis; a different BLAS/LAPACK build changes that basis in the clustered bulk and moves rom by the C_REL5 amount for well-fit arms.  Reproduce inside this contract, or read rom with its sensitivity class.

classes.eigenvalue_only: lam_bar and any symmetric function of the spectrum reproduce at f64 round-off (~1e-15) across BLAS/LAPACK builds
classes.eigenvector_projected: lam_eff, and therefore rom, reproduce at ~1e-11 for arms whose residual sits on the well-separated small-lambda half, and only at ~1e-5 (C_REL5) for WELL-FIT arms whose residual spreads over the clustered bulk

rom_sensitivity_class.v2_arms_read_as: eigenvector_projected -- the v2 lane roms in results.cross_evaluation.per_seed carry this sensitivity class against any re-run under a different BLAS/LAPACK build; they are internally consistent within the contract recorded above (verified bit-identical across two host classes on 2026-09-10)

secondary_class.justification: The BETA1 arms are the WELL-FIT arms of this panel: their residual S-norm is ~4.6e-6 (median dwS) against ~0.16 for the sealed control arms, and only 41-48% of their residual projection weight sits on the small-lambda half of the spectrum against 99.3-99.4% for the controls.  Their rom therefore reads lam_eff = (lambda . a^2)/sum(a^2) with a = VP^T S dw out of the CLUSTERED BULK of the panel spectrum, where the eigenVECTORS rotate by ~eps/gap under any change of the eigen-solver.  The eigen-basis is a LAPACK-BUILD-dependent quantity: re-running the pinned harness today reproduces the sealed C5 geometry's true_S_rows_sha256 BIT-IDENTICALLY but NOT its lam_rows_sha256, whereas C5 itself (Aug 2026) rebuilt the geometry and reproduced the GEO-spine control roms at rel_dev exactly 0.  lam_bar (a symmetric function of the eigenvalues, invariant under eigenvector rotation) still reproduces at f64 round-off, 7.9e-16 median / 4.5e-15 max per row.  Measured consequence on 2026-09-10 (ondemand-1, 112 vCPU x86, and reproduced bit-for-bit on a 4-core workstation): the seven control arms reproduce the sealed GEO-spine roms at <= 4.0e-11, five orders inside C-REL6, while the three BETA1 arms deviate from the sealed C5 roms at 2.73e-6 (s42) / 3.03e-6 (s43) / 6.84e-6 (s44).  C_REL5 = 1e-5 is one decade above the measured maximum and is applied ONLY to g_published_beta1_reproduced; it is NOT a relaxation of any geometry check.
secondary_class.name: C_REL5

tolerance.statement: sealed geometry SCALARS (rom) are reproduced under the parent's own TOL_REL6 = 1e-6 (expc2_geo_spine.py:225); input FILE identity and panel ARRAY identity are byte-exact (C-BYTE) and gated separately; the v2 forwards are gated deterministic and, where a sealed V2-CLEAN panel record exists, bit-identical to its logits.
